title: MC skill frontmatter schema
description: Canonical frontmatter for files under .claude/commands/<ns>/<name>.md. Enforced by /skills:create and the skill-frontmatter-guard hook.

description.description: One sentence (<=200 chars) describing what the skill does. Shown in /help and the skills list.

user-invocable.description: True if invoked by the user via slash. False/absent = internal/agent-only.

reads.description: paths.X tokens this skill reads from. Use [] if pure side-effect.

writes.description: paths.X tokens this skill writes to. Use [] for read-only.

migrates.description: Only for migration skills. Declares supported version range.
